description: This file provides utility functions for managing local storage, exporting/importing app state, handling JSON files, and data normalization/migration for a Habit and Task tracking React application.

methods.name: getStorageKey
methods.description: Returns the localStorage key used by this app.

methods.name: getStateFromStorage
methods.description: Load AppState from localStorage, performing migration if necessary.

methods.name: setStateToStorage
methods.description: Persist AppState to localStorage with version envelope.

methods.name: makeExportFilename
methods.description: Builds an export filename based on current date/time.

methods.name: buildExportPayloadV2
methods.description: Builds an export payload (version 2) from the current app state.

methods.name: downloadJSON
methods.description: Triggers a client-side download of JSON data.

methods.name: readJSONFile
methods.description: Reads and parses a JSON file selected via HTML input.

methods.name: validateImportFile
methods.description: Validates file size and type before import.

methods.name: validateAndNormalizeImportPayload
methods.description: Validates and normalizes an import payload (v1/v2).

methods.name: applyImportToState
methods.description: Merges or replaces current app state with imported data based on mode.

methods.name: createLocalBackupEntry
methods.description: Creates a backup entry stored in localStorage for recovery.

methods.name: getBackupHistory
methods.description: Retrieves list of backup entries from localStorage.

methods.name: getLastBackupEntry
methods.description: Returns the most recent backup entry.

methods.name: restoreBackupEntry
methods.description: Validates and normalizes a backup entry's payload for restoration.
